description: A Flutter widget implementing the AttendanceScreen, which displays a date range picker, fetch button, and a list of attendance records. It uses providers for state management and external widgets for UI components.

classes.name: AttendanceScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays and manages attendance records within a selected date range.

classes.name: _AttendanceScreenState
classes.description: State class for AttendanceScreen managing the UI state, data fetching, and user interactions.

classes.name: _StatusChip
classes.description: A custom StatelessWidget displaying a status indicator chip based on attendance status.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches attendance data for the selected date range from the provider.

methods.name: _pickRange
methods.description: Opens a date range picker dialog for user to select a new date range.
